title: BTC-ETH spot-led breakout with limited leverage expansion
hypothesis: When BTC and ETH jointly break to fresh 24-hour highs while BTC contract open interest is flat-to-lower and funding remains non-extreme, 1-4 hour continuation quality is better than a leverage-driven breakout, but the bias should remain conditional until order-flow and breadth confirmation arrives.
mechanism: Price appreciation without proportional contract-OI growth suggests the move is not primarily new crowded leverage. Positive but modest funding and a small negative premium reduce immediate long-crowding risk. ETH participation adds cross-asset confirmation, while absent taker, liquidation, depth and reliable Polymarket probability-velocity confirmation cap confidence.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: Paper-only candidate state detector evaluated on point-in-time snapshots: TREND_UP_CANDIDATE = BTC_return_1h >= rolling_past_180d_same_utc_hour_q80 AND BTC_distance_to_24h_high <= 0.25% AND ETH_return_1h > 0 AND BTC_OI_contract_change_1h <= +0.50% AND BTC_funding <= rolling_past_90d_q75 AND abs(BTC_perpetual_premium) <= 10 bps. Upgrade to CONFIRMED_CONTINUATION only if at least one independent microstructure condition also holds: taker_buy_ratio_5m >= past_30d_q67, bid_microprice_pressure_z >= 1, or breadth_positive_share_top50_5m >= past_30d_q67. If confirmation is absent, record CONDITIONAL only; do not alter, size, open, close, or route any live position.
required_data: Point-in-time BTC and ETH perpetual bid/ask/last prices at 1-minute or finer resolution
Prospectively timestamped BTC contract open interest with firstObservedAt and ingestedAt
Current and settled funding plus perpetual premium/index basis
Top-50 liquid perpetual breadth and returns
Taker buy/sell flow, L2 depth, spread, microprice and liquidation lower-bound stream
Polymarket price-threshold probability history with observation timestamp, spread, liquidity and volume
transaction_cost_implications: Do not chase the breakout when spread, Q-sized entry book-walk, expected adverse markout, funding drag and stressed exit cost consume the predicted edge. Test immediate entry against 5/15-minute confirmation-delay shadows and include 1.5x and 2x fee/slippage stress; delayed confirmation may improve false-breakout selection but can forfeit early continuation returns.
expected_benefit: Potentially distinguish healthier spot/short-covering-led continuation from crowded OI-expansion breakouts, improving 1-4 hour trade selection without using a hard veto and while preserving baseline trade frequency through conditional scoring.
risks: The current observation may be a weekend liquidity move, short covering, or a false breakout. OKX alone does not establish cross-exchange confirmation. Contract OI can fall during short covering without implying durable spot demand. Polymarket threshold odds did not provide a verified fresh probability-velocity confirmation. Missing taker, liquidation, breadth and full-depth data prevents high confidence. Historical Binance OI archives may contain point-in-time timestamp ambiguity and must not be used as labeled without the existing data gate.
falsification_criteria: REJECT if, after costs, the confirmed state does not exceed matched baseline net PnL or profit factor; if maximum drawdown worsens by more than 5%; if benefit disappears under 1.5x costs; if OI-flat breakouts do not outperform OI-expansion breakouts on forward 1h/4h returns or MAE; if results are driven by fewer than five event clusters; if added confirmation reduces retained trades below 98%; or if prospective point-in-time OI does not reproduce the relationship.
validation_plan: Use only causal snapshots satisfying usableAt <= decision_time. Develop thresholds on 2024-2025, validate unchanged on January-June 2026, and use July-September 2026 once as a locked historical test only where point-in-time semantics are verified. Because archived OI timing is suspect, treat the primary OI result as prospective: freeze the rule and run at least 90 future days in paper shadow. Compare BASELINE, PRICE_ONLY, PRICE_X_OI_FLAT, PRICE_X_FUNDING, FULL_CONFIRMATION, 5M_DELAY, 15M_DELAY and matched-frequency random controls. Report net PnL, profit factor, maximum drawdown, MAE/MFE, implementation shortfall, retention, trade count, capital utilization and 1.5x/2x cost sensitivity with day/event-block bootstrap.
minimum_sample: At least 200 independent breakout episodes, 100 with flat-or-lower OI, 100 with expanding OI, 500 eligible baseline decisions, and at least 90 prospective calendar days; extend the shadow until all counts are met.

primary_drivers: no verified taker or depth confirmation

contradictions: Price made fresh 24-hour highs, but BTC contract OI was slightly lower than the prior observation rather than expanding.
Funding rose but remained modest; the reported premium stayed slightly negative.
ETH confirmed direction but lagged BTC on the 24-hour change.
No verified fresh Polymarket probability acceleration, taker-flow, liquidation or L2-depth confirmation was available.
invalidation_triggers: BTC loses 85900 and fails to reclaim it on a completed 15-minute observation.
BTC contract OI rises more than 1.5% in one hour while price stalls or falls.
Funding enters its rolling 90-day top decile or premium exceeds +10 bps without breadth confirmation.
ETH turns negative over one hour while BTC remains near the high.
Top-50 breadth falls below 40% positive or Q-sized book-walk exceeds the predicted edge.

relevant_market_titles: What price will Bitcoin hit in October?
polymarket_context.probability_now: No reliable fresh point estimate used; the latest accessible official page showed the $90,000 threshold near 51%, but no trustworthy short-horizon probability change series.
polymarket_context.liquidity_spread_oi_volume_observations: Official page showed about $1.94M aggregate event volume; outcome-level spread and open interest were not reliably available in the fresh snapshot.
polymarket_context.reliability_notes: Useful only as low-weight context because threshold events overlap, some outcomes have already resolved, and no point-in-time order-book history was obtained.

derivatives_context.observations: Relative to the prior official snapshot, BTC and ETH advanced to fresh intraday highs while BTC contract OI edged lower; this is consistent with, but does not prove, a less leverage-crowded move.

macro_news_context: No new official macro release or regulatory announcement was found that independently explained the move. Existing rates uncertainty limits 24-hour confidence.
